events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The conflict in Iran is escalating, with the US and its allies involved. This has significant implications for global markets, particularly oil prices. The situation is highly volatile and unpredictable.
events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran is likely to disrupt oil supplies, leading to higher prices. This will benefit oil services companies, making OIH a good buy. On the other hand, emerging markets are likely to be negatively impacted by the conflict, making EEM a good short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and conflict developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates
